content.text: Most Algarve golf courses have somewhere to warm up, but practice facilities vary a lot: some clubs have big grass ranges with dozens of bays and target greens, others a netted hitting area or just a chipping and putting green. This guide brings together what the clubs themselves publish about their driving ranges, short-game areas and range-ball prices, area by area, so you can find a good place to practise near where you're staying.

It isn't a complete list. Some clubs publish very little about their practice facilities, so if a course you like isn't here, it may still have a good range: check its page on our site or ask the club. Opening hours are rarely published anywhere, so it's always worth checking before you go.
What range balls cost in the Algarve
Only some clubs publish a price for range balls. These are the prices on their own price lists:

content.text: Western Algarve: Lagos, Alvor and Portimão
Morgado and Álamos

The [practice ground](/courses/morgado/practice-facilities) shared by [Morgado](/courses/morgado) and [Álamos](/courses/alamos) near Portimão is a big one: two natural-grass tees with room for 35 players each, ten target greens marked every 50 metres, two chipping greens with bunkers, and putting greens at each tee. The [Morgado Golf Academy](/golf-academies/morgado-golf-academy) teaches here.
Penina

[Penina](/courses/penina-championship/practice-facilities) has an 80-metre-wide driving range on natural Bermuda grass, with target greens, a chipping green, a practice bunker and a putting green. Its nine-hole Resort Course needs no handicap certificate, so it's a natural next step after a session on the range. See the [Penina Golf Academy](/golf-academies/penina-golf-academy) for lessons and clinics.
Palmares
[Palmares](/courses/palmares/practice-facilities) has a 300-yard driving range set in a natural valley above Lagos, with short-game areas and putting greens, and views of the coast.
Espiche and Santo António

Near Lagos, [Espiche](/courses/espiche/practice-facilities) has a range for up to 29 players on both natural grass and mats, a 400 m² putting green and an 800 m² chipping area. Further west, [Santo António](/courses/santo-antonio/practice-facilities), near Vila do Bispo, has 10 open-air and 4 covered practice tees, a putting green beside the range and a short-game area behind the 1st tee, and its 2026 price list gives a token of 48 balls at €4.
Boavista

[Boavista](/courses/boavista#practice) near Lagos has a short-game area with three greens: one for putting, one for chipping and one surrounded by bunkers. Its driving range is currently closed for repair work, with no reopening date given, so check with the club before you go.
Central Algarve: Carvoeiro, Silves and Albufeira
Pestana Golf

The Pestana Golf Academy has covered hitting bays, eight target greens, a chipping area with practice bunkers and a large putting green, and Pestana's price list gives a range token of 50 balls at €7 for its courses ([Gramacho](/courses/gramacho), [Vale da Pinta](/courses/vale-da-pinta), [Silves](/courses/silves), [Alto](/courses/alto-golf) and [Vila Sol](/courses/vila-sol)). Pestana's website doesn't say which course each range is at, so ask when you book.
Amendoeira

[Amendoeira](/courses/amendoeira-faldo#practice) has a driving range, putting greens and long and short game practice areas, plus a floodlit nine-hole par-3 academy course between the Faldo and O'Connor courses, useful for evening practice. See the [Amendoeira Golf Academy](/golf-academies/amendoeira-golf-academy).
Balaia, Salgados and Pine Cliffs

[Balaia](/courses/balaia/practice-facilities) has a practice range next to the clubhouse and publishes ball prices from €2 for a bucket of 24. [Salgados](/courses/salgados#practice) lists a short-game practice area, a putting green, a chipping green and golf simulators on its website; independent listings say it also has a driving range, but the club's own site doesn't mention one, so ask. At [Pine Cliffs](/courses/pine-cliffs#practice), range balls are included in the resort's unlimited-golf packages.
Vilamoura, Quinta do Lago and Vale do Lobo
Vilamoura

Each of the four Vilamoura courses ([Old Course](/courses/vilamoura-old-course), [Pinhal](/courses/vilamoura-pinhal), [Laguna](/courses/vilamoura-laguna) and [Millennium](/courses/vilamoura-millennium)) has its own practice facilities, with a driving range, putting green and chipping area. The [Vilamoura Golf Academy](/golf-academies/vilamoura-golf-academy) is based at Pinhal, where the clubhouse looks over the range.
Pinheiros Altos

[Pinheiros Altos](/courses/pinheiros-altos/practice-facilities) near Almancil publishes a practice fee for visitors: €25 for a day with unlimited balls, or €15 after 13:30. It has room for up to 30 players, two practice putting greens, a chipping and bunker area and three teaching bays, one of them a Titleist fitting centre.
Quinta do Lago and Vale do Lobo

[Quinta do Lago](/courses/quinta-do-lago-south#practice) has two practice ranges, one at Quinta do Lago and one at Laranjal, plus the Paul McGinley academy and a TaylorMade Performance Centre for fitting. Next door, the [Vale do Lobo](/courses/vale-do-lobo-royal#practice) academy has a netted hitting area rather than an open range, with a grass short-game area with bunkers and a putting green by the clubhouse.
Eastern Algarve: Tavira and Castro Marim
Benamor

[Benamor](/courses/benamor/practice-facilities) near Tavira describes its range in detail: 16 mats at the front, practice on grass at the top end with target flags and distance markers, a chipping and pitching green with a bunker, and a nine-hole putting green between the clubhouse and the range. Balls are sold as tokens at reception.
Quinta da Ria and Quinta do Vale

[Quinta da Ria](/courses/quinta-da-ria/practice-facilities) has a 300-metre range with 70 grass bays and 5 covered bays, a Foresight simulator, a chipping area with a bunker and a nine-hole pitch-and-putt academy course. Close to Castro Marim, [Quinta do Vale](/courses/quinta-do-vale/practice-facilities) has a very large range in two zones (room for 30 players on one side and 65 on the other), a chipping green with a bunker, putting greens and a short-game academy course.
Castro Marim and Monte Rei

[Castro Marim](/courses/castro-marim/practice-facilities) sells balls in three bucket sizes and has a range card that doubles your credit when you top it up with €50 or more. [Monte Rei](/courses/monte-rei#practice) has a driving range, short-game areas and a putting green, improved during its 2026 renovation, and a Swing Studio for teaching and fitting.
Tips for practising in the Algarve
**Check the opening hours.** Very few clubs publish them, and ranges can close earlier than the course or be busy with lessons at certain times.
**Grass or mats?** Where the club says so, we've noted it on each course page. Benamor and Espiche, for example, have both mats and grass.

**Want lessons too?** Many of these practice grounds are home to a teaching academy. See our guide to [golf lessons in the Algarve](/guide/golf-lessons-in-the-algarve) and the [golf academies](/golf-academies) pages for prices and programmes.
